license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene in this state except those who are duly licensed as dentists, dental therapists, or dental hygienists pursuant to this article 220

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Colorado dental board created in section 12-220-105

name.quote: "Board" means the Colorado dental board created in section 12-220-105

type.quote: Colorado dental board created in section 12-220-105

degree_required.value: Graduate of accredited dental school or college
degree_required.quote: Is a graduate of a dental school or college that, at the time of the applicant's graduation, was accredited

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation or successor
accrediting_body.quote: accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation or its successor commission

exams.name: Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations
exams.jurisdiction: national (Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations)
exams.quote: The examination administered by the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations

exams.name: Clinical skills and knowledge examination
exams.quote: An examination or other methodology, as determined by the board, designed to test the applicant's clinical skills and knowledge, which may include residency and portfolio models

interval_years.quote: Licenses, certifications, and registrations issued pursuant to a part or article of this title 12 expire pursuant to a schedule established by the director

required.quote: As a condition of renewing, reactivating, or reinstating a license issued under this article 220, every dentist, dental therapist, and dental hygienist must obtain at least thirty hours of continuing education every two years

hours_per_period.quote: must obtain at least thirty hours of continuing education every two years

period_years.quote: must obtain at least thirty hours of continuing education every two years

exists.quote: Colorado dental board created in section 12-220-105

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene in this state except those who are duly licensed as dentists, dental therapists, or dental hygienists pursuant to this article 220

credential_type.quote: "License" has the meaning specified in section 12-20-102 (9) and includes an academic license to practice dentistry pursuant to section 12-220-402. A license is a privilege personal to the licensee

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene in this state except those who are duly licensed

title_protection.quote: Represents himself or herself to an individual or the general public as practicing dentistry, by using the words "dentist" or "dental surgeon", or by using the letters "D.D.S.", "D.M.D.", "D.D.S./M.D.", or "D.M.D./M.D."

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene in this state except those who are duly licensed as dentists, dental therapists, or dental hygienists

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for or securing a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for, securing, renewing, or seeking reinstatement of a license to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or crime violating the dental practice act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or any crime that constitutes a violation of this article 220

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing habit-forming drugs or controlled substances outside legitimate professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing a habit-forming drug or controlled substance to a person, including the applicant or licensee, other than in the course of legitimate professional practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitually abusing or excessively using alcohol, habit-forming drugs, or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitually abusing or excessively using alcohol, a habit-forming drug, or a controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting unlicensed practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting, in the practice of dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene, a person who is not licensed to practice dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing as a partner, agent, or employee with unlicensed persons
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene as a partner, agent, or employee of or in joint venture with any person who does not hold a license to practice dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate any provision of the dental practice act or board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate any provision or term of this article 220

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the board of physical illness or behavioral health condition affecting ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to notify the board, as required by section 12-30-108 (1), of a physical illness, physical condition, or behavioral health, mental health, or substance use disorder that renders the licensee unable

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an act or omission constituting grossly negligent dental practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an act or omission that constitutes grossly negligent dental, dental therapy, or dental hygiene practice or that fails to meet generally accepted standards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising in a manner that is misleading, deceptive, or false
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising in a manner that is misleading, deceptive, or false

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a sexual act with a patient during or within six months of professional relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in a sexual act with a patient during the course of patient care or within six months immediately following the termination of the licensee's professional relationship with the patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to make patient records available to a patient upon written request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to make patient records available to a patient pursuant to a written authorization-request

disciplinary_grounds.description: False billing or fraudulent insurance practices
disciplinary_grounds.quote: False billing in the delivery of dental, dental therapy, or dental hygiene services, including performing one service and billing for another, billing for any service not rendered

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the board of malpractice judgment or settlement within ninety days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to notify the board, in writing and within ninety days after a judgment is entered, of a final judgment by a court of competent jurisdiction in favor of any party and against the licensee involving negligent malpractice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to furnish unlicensed persons with laboratory work orders
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to furnish unlicensed persons with laboratory work orders pursuant to section 12-220-502

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing a solicitor or other agent to obtain patronage
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing a solicitor or other agent to obtain patronage, except as provided in section 12-220-309

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully deceiving or attempting to deceive the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully deceiving or attempting to deceive the board or its agents with reference to any matter relating to this article 220

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sharing professional fees with persons not lawfully associated in practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sharing any professional fees with anyone except those with whom the dentist, dental therapist, or dental hygienist is lawfully associated in the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide reasonably necessary referral to other licensed professionals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide reasonably necessary referral of a patient to other licensed dentists or licensed health-care professionals for consultation or treatment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Ordering or performing demonstrably unnecessary treatment or laboratory tests
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully and repeatedly ordering or performing, without clinical justification, demonstrably unnecessary laboratory tests or studies

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying or repeatedly making incorrect entries in patient records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsifying or repeatedly making incorrect essential entries or repeatedly failing to make essential entries on patient records

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering local anesthesia or sedation without obtaining required permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering local anesthesia, minimal sedation, moderate sedation, or deep sedation/general anesthesia without obtaining a permit from the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report surrender or adverse action on license in another state within ninety days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board, within ninety days after final disposition, the surrender of a license to, or adverse action taken against a license by, a licensing agency in another state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide adequate or proper supervision of unlicensed persons
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide adequate or proper supervision of unlicensed persons in dental, dental therapy, or dental hygiene practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct that constitutes a crime relating to the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any conduct that constitutes a crime as defined in title 18, which conduct relates to the licensee's practice as a dentist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing outside the scope of dental practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing outside the scope of dental, dental therapy, or dental hygiene practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to establish and maintain required professional liability insurance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to establish and continuously maintain financial responsibility or professional liability insurance as required by section 12-220-307

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising as a specialist without completing required education
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising or otherwise holding oneself out to the public as practicing a dental specialty in which the dentist has not successfully completed the education specified for the dental specialty

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to respond in honest, materially responsive, and timely manner to a complaint
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to respond in an honest, materially responsive, and timely manner to a complaint filed against the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an act or omission that fails to meet generally accepted standards for infection control
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an act or omission that fails to meet generally accepted standards for infection control

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering moderate or deep sedation without qualified personnel present
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering moderate sedation or deep sedation/general anesthesia without a licensed dentist or other licensed health-care professional qualified to administer the relevant level of sedation or anesthesia present in the operatory

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to complete and maintain records of required continuing education
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to complete and maintain records of completing continuing education as required by section 12-220-308

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with interim therapeutic restoration requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with section 12-220-505 regarding the placement of interim therapeutic restorations

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with silver diamine fluoride application requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with sections 12-220-501 (1)(a)(II)(C) and 12-220-503 (1)(g) and rules adopted pursuant to those sections regarding the application of silver diamine fluoride

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to accurately complete and submit required questionnaire
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to accurately complete and submit the questionnaire required by section 12-220-408 (2)

definition_quote.value: "Dentistry" means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, including nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures, of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area, or the adjacent and associated structures and the impact of the disease, disorder, or condition on the human body so long as a dentist is practicing within the scope of the dentist's education, training, and experience and in accordance with applicable law
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, including nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures, of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area, or the adjacent and associated structures

methods_authorized.quote: the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, including nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures, of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe drugs or medicine and administer local anesthesia, analgesia, minimal sedation, moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia
drug_authority.quote: A licensed dentist is authorized to: Prescribe drugs or medicine; Perform surgical operations; Administer, pursuant to board rules, local anesthesia, analgesia including nitrous oxide/oxygen inhalation, medication prescribed or administered for the relief of anxiety or apprehension, minimal sedation, moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: A licensed dentist who obtains an anesthesia or sedation permit pursuant to this section may administer minimal sedation, moderate sedation, or deep sedation/general anesthesia. A licensed dentist who administers minimal sedation, moderate sedation, or deep sedation/general anesthesia to pediatric dental patients shall obtain a permit designated by the board to allow for administration to pediatric dental patients

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: The board shall establish, by rule, criteria and procedures for an office inspection program to be completed upon application and renewal of anesthesia or sedation permits

pediatric_sedation_endorsement_required.quote: A licensed dentist who administers minimal sedation, moderate sedation, or deep sedation/general anesthesia to pediatric dental patients shall obtain a permit designated by the board to allow for administration to pediatric dental patients

specialist_license_available.quote: The board may recognize those dental specialties defined by the American Dental Association

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means the supervision of those tasks or procedures that do not require the presence of the dentist in the room where performed but require the dentist's presence on the premises and availability for prompt consultation and treatment... "Indirect supervision" means the supervision of those tasks or procedures that do not require the presence of the dentist in the office or on the premises at the time the tasks or procedures are being performed, but do require that the tasks be performed with the prior knowledge and consent of the dentist.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: A dental hygienist proprietor, or a professional corporation or professional limited liability corporation of dental hygienists, in addition to providing dental hygiene services, may enter into an agreement with one or more dentists for the lease or rental of equipment or office space

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A dental hygienist may place an interim therapeutic restoration only after a dentist provides a diagnosis, treatment plan, and instruction to perform the procedure

dental_therapist_license_available.quote: Effective May 1, 2023, every person who desires to qualify for practice as a dental therapist within this state must file with the board

dental_therapist_collaborative_practice_.quote: A dental therapist may perform the following tasks and procedures under the direct supervision of a licensed dentist or under the indirect supervision of a licensed dentist pursuant to a written articulated plan with the dentist

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Only a dentist licensed to practice dentistry in this state pursuant to this article 220 may be the proprietor of a dental practice in this state

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: A dentist shall not prescribe, distribute, or give to any person, including the dentist, any habit-forming drug or any controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5) or as contained in schedule II of 21 U.S.C. sec. 812, other than in the course of legitimate dental practice

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Each prescriber licensed in this state who holds a current registration issued by the federal drug enforcement administration shall register and maintain a user account as specified in section 12-280-403

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: A licensed dentist who uses the services of an unlicensed technician for the purpose of constructing, altering, repairing, or duplicating any denture, bridge, splint, or orthodontic or prosthetic appliance shall furnish the unlicensed technician with a written or electronic laboratory work order

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: Administering local anesthesia under the indirect supervision of a licensed dentist pursuant to rules of the board, including minimum education requirements and procedures for local anesthesia administration

interim_therapeutic_restoration_authoriz.quote: "Interim therapeutic restoration" or "ITR" means a direct provisional restoration placed to stabilize a tooth until a licensed dentist can assess the need for further definitive treatment

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: Unsupervised dental hygiene may be performed by licensed dental hygienists without the supervision of a licensed dentist
